expectations.input: Format/Format$ with named formats, four numeric sections, string placeholders and documented date/time tokens

expected.named: numeric, Boolean, date and time names are case-insensitive
expected.numericSections: positive, negative, zero and Null sections
expected.stringMasks: @, &, <, > and ! with quoted and escaped literals
expected.dateTokens: c, d through dddddd, w, ww, m through mmmm, q, y, yy, yyyy, h, n, s, ttttt and AM/PM variants
expected.locale: VB6Sp6 uses active separators, patterns, names and currency; Deterministic is invariant

expected.variantState: Null propagates and Empty is numeric zero
expected.numericSubtypes: Abs, Fix and Int preserve numeric Variant subtypes including Currency and Date
expected.negativeFractions: Fix truncates toward zero while Int rounds toward negative infinity
expected.domains: Sqr, Log and Exp enforce documented domain and overflow contracts
expected.random: Rnd and Randomize use the repeatable VB6 24-bit sequence

expectations.input: FV/PV/PMT/IPmt/PPmt/NPer/Rate/NPV/IRR/MIRR/SLN/SYD/DDB with annuities, cash flows and depreciation schedules

expected.paymentBreakdown: IPmt plus PPmt equals Pmt for each supported period
expected.periodAndRate: NPer and Rate round-trip an annuity
expected.invalidArguments: diagnostic for zero NPer, unsupported Type, invalid period or invalid cash-flow rates
expected.irr: IRR and MIRR solve explicit Variant-array cash-flow contracts
expected.depreciation: SLN, SYD and DDB schedule formulas

expectations.input: Dim values(5 To 7) As Long; values(5) = 42
Declare callback with SAFEARRAY(Date) and SAFEARRAY(Currency)
